title: Authorization Compositor and Audit Orchestrator for RBAC v2
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Build a pluggable 'authorization compositor' service that aggregates policy evaluation outputs (RBAC v2 rules, attribute-based predicates, external entitlements) and an 'audit orchestrator' that enriches, normalizes, and streams authorization events to the audit pipeline. This ticket implements the runtime middleware shims used by API, runtime, and console services so decisions are consistent, explainable, and auditable. Scope excludes UI UX polish for console admin views (separate ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Authorization Compositor returns a single canonical decision JSON for a request combining local RBAC rules, SAML/SSO mapped attributes, and external entitlement fetches
Audit Orchestrator emits augmented audit events to kafka://redwood-audit (schema v2) with explainable_reason and decision_trace fields
Middleware respects tenant-level overrides and admin soft-fail policy during controlled rollouts
End-to-end tests validating allow/deny paths with at least 3 decision sources and simulated network failures for external entitlement service
Latency overhead added by compositor + orchestrator under p95 load is <= 3ms on node with warm cache
implementation_notes: Composable stages: (1) Principal normalization (SSO/SAML attributes), (2) Attribute enrichment (external entitlements, org tags), (3) Rule evaluation ordering and short-circuiting, (4) Decision composition and scoring, (5) Audit event generation
Policy cache will be sharded by tenant and version; use LRU with TTL and eviction hooks to warm cache on deployment
Expose a debug hook /_authz/explain (internal only) that returns decision_trace when X-Debug-Auth header present
Fallback behavior: on upstream entitlement timeout, use 'cached-stale' policy with audit tag 'fallback:entitlement-stale'
Implement scorer to resolve conflicting allow/deny from multiple sources: deny with deny-reason takes precedence unless explicit admin override flag present
All decision payloads must carry a trace_id and request_context for correlation with console traces and observability
design_alternatives_considered: Centralized decision microservice vs embedded middleware: chose embedded middleware with optional central compositor to minimize cross-region latency for hot paths
Synchronous external entitlement calls vs async enrichment: use synchronous with short timeout and fallback to async refresh for less sensitive attributes
Binary allow/deny vs graded decision scores: retain binary enforcement but include graded scoring for telemetry and policy debugging
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): deploy compositor + orchestrator behind feature-flag to 5% of API traffic (internal orgs) with admin soft-fail enabled
Phase 2 (observability): monitor p50/p95 latency, decision divergence metric, and audit volume for 72 hours
Phase 3 (validation): run synthetic evaluation harness that replays production auth traffic and compare decisions against legacy authorizer
Phase 4 (gradual ramp): increase to 50% then 100% with hard enforcement enabled; migrate console routes afterward
Rollback: feature-flag off and consume cached decisions while debug traces are collected
testing_plan: Unit tests for composer stages and scorer logic (coverage >= 90%)
Integration tests: mock SAML attribute endpoint and external entitlement service; assert decision_trace fields
Chaos tests: simulate timeouts and partial failures, validate fallback tags in audit events
Load test: verify p95 latency delta under synthetic token-level workload
Security tests: pen-test simple bypass scenarios and validate no sensitive attributes leak in audit streams
migration_notes: Existing audit schema v1 consumers must be migrated. Audit Orchestrator will emit dual events (v1 compatibility envelope + v2 payload) for 30 days. Notify downstream teams and provide sample consumer code in /confluence/audit-migration.md.
observability_and_metrics: Emit metrics: compositon_latency_ms (histogram), decision_source_counts (counter by source), decision_divergence_rate, audit_event_size_bytes, audit_enqueue_latency_ms. Add structured logs with event_id and trace_id for sampled requests.
security_considerations: Ensure PII redaction for attributes in audit payloads. All external entitlement calls must use mTLS and short-lived credentials. Audit Orchestrator must support KMS-encrypted payloads when tenant requires. Security review scheduled.
